book.name: 1 TESALONICABO
book.title: 1 TESALONICABO Tesalonicabo qui Pablonen raanni joi

content: Jenquetsahpabo netebo jayaxihquiquin. Jenquetsahpabo bari tian jayaxihquiquin. Man tah man honanscai. Jaa copi tah non jahuabi mato huishati pishinyamahi.
Yame yometso sanareneni jahuicamahi ta noquen Hihbo joti nete nocorenentihiqui. Man tah man honanquin sirijascai.

Tsoabi ta rehtenanyamascaiqui, jahua qui raquetima ta jaiqui jaibaan bi ta histon bi res Papan jato queyoyaxihquiqui. Haibo tohoya baque bihcatsihquish hisinrenenihcamahi histon jahui. Tsoabi ta cahnetimahiqui.
Mato tah man jaabo quescayamahi bahquish chian jihueyamahi, noquen huetsabaan, yometso quescayamahi ta jaa nete mato qui nocoyaxihquiqui.
Xaba baquebo rahsi tah man qui, nete baquebo. Noque tah non yame baqueboma qui, bahquish baqueboma.
Jaa copi caibo hihqui quescayamahi hoxan hihyamanahue. Mohinahue, pahenihcamayamahi.
Hoxanicabo cahen yame hoxahi. Pahenicabo cahen yame pahencani.
Nete mehabo hihquish coiramenahue. Hahan xohpaxti sahuexon hahcajaxon nincacoinnahue, joni huetsahon shinanxon. Boxpaxti maixon hahcajaxon man teehihribitihi honannahue.
Noque rainyamanoxonma bi ta noquen Hihbo Jesucristonen noque teehihmanon Papan yohinishqui.
Noquen Hihbo ta noque copi mahuanishqui, mohiyamahax mahuatax non hahbetan hihnon.
Jaa copi coshijahanannahue, sirijaquin shinanahbo. Yohiquin joni huetsa shinan hinanhahnannahue, man hahcai quescajaquin.
Noquen huetsabo jihueti Pablonen yohihi
Maton pastorobaan ta mato beboxoniqui. Beboxonquin mato sirijaquin yohihah nincanahue, noque huetsabon. Jaa tah non mato hihti yohihi.
Jaton tee copi man jatohon hihti shinannon tah non mato yohihi. Maton huetsabo betan rihbi siripi jihuenahue.

Chiquishaibo teetahbo jato sirijaquin yohinahue, noquen huetsabaan. Man jascajati tah non hihti queenai. Yobacahinyamahibo coshihahbo jato shinan hinannahue. Yosmahibo yanapannahue. Noquen huetsabo jatihibi tenexon honaxonbi yohinahue.
Caibaan mato tiromajahah bi copiyamanahue. Copixonma maton huetsabo hahxonnahue, jatihibi jonibo rihbi hahxonquin.
Jenimahi jihuenahue.
Noquen Papa jaayocanahue.
Hahxon tah min noque jai Papan hahnahue, jatihibi copi. Man Jesucriston jonibo jascati ta noquen Papa queenihqui.
Dios Yoshiman mato shinanmahiya jointi chahomayamanahue.
Papan joi yohihiboya nincanahue.
Hihresyamanahue: jatihibi honannahue, siriti caisnoxon.
Jahuabi tiromahi quescapajati shinanyamabiresnahue.

Mato tah hen yocaxonai, sirijaquin shinanmanica hihxon Papanbi mato jatihobi mequexonnon noquen Hihbo Jesucristo jonon caman. Maton yoshin, maton shinan, maton yora, jatihobi mato hohchajoma bexojanon, mato qui jahua tiroma yohuanti yamanon.
Mato quenanicaton ta jan yohini quescabijaquin mato hahxonyaxihquiqui. Jaan ta pishinmatimahiqui.
Quirica janquenjahi
Noque rihbi yocaxonnahue, noque huetsabon.
Jatihibi noquen huetsabo noque yohixonnahue, Man jascabi jayamahin, hahquin.
Noquen Hihbaan yonohah tah hen mato hihti yohihi, nea quirica man jatihibi noquen huetsabo nincamanon.
Noquen Hihbo Jesucristonen jahuen shinan siri mato hinana jihuenahue hah tah hen jai.
